180	class CodeIndexJobsStore:
181	    """Thin DAO over one WAL-mode SQLite database shared by all repos."""
182	
183	    def __init__(self, db_path: str | Path) -> None:
184	        self._db_path = str(db_path)
185	        if self._db_path != ":memory:":
186	            Path(self._db_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
187	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
188	        conn = sqlite3.connect(self._db_path, check_same_thread=False, isolation_level=None)
189	        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
190	        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
191	        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL")
192	        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
193	        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
194	        conn.executescript(_DDL)
195	        self._apply_migrations(conn)
196	        self._conn: sqlite3.Connection | None = conn
197	
198	    @staticmethod
199	    def _apply_migrations(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
200	        """Additive schema migrations (ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN) for existing DBs."""
201	        for table, column, ddl in _MIGRATIONS:
202	            cols = {str(r["name"]) for r in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")}
203	            if column not in cols:
204	                conn.execute(ddl)
205	
206	    @property
207	    def conn(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
208	        if self._conn is None:
209	            raise RuntimeError("CodeIndexJobsStore is closed")
210	        return self._conn
211	
212	    def close(self) -> None:
213	        if self._conn is not None:
214	            try:
215	                self._conn.close()
216	            except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
217	                logger.debug("failed to close jobs sqlite connection", exc_info=True)
218	            self._conn = None

222	    def create_job(
223	        self,
224	        *,
225	        slug: str,
226	        repo_path: str,
227	        kind: str = "index",
228	        force_reindex: bool = False,
229	        worker_token: str | None = None,
230	        job_id: str | None = None,
231	        initial_status: str = "running",

233	    ) -> CodeIndexJob:
234	        """Insert a new job row and return its snapshot."""
235	        job_id = job_id or str(uuid.uuid4())
236	        now = time.time()
237	        with self._lock:
238	            self.conn.execute(
239	                """
240	                INSERT INTO jobs (
241	                  job_id, kind, slug, repo_path, status, phase,
242	                  force_reindex, worker_token, started_at, updated_at
243	                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

251	                    initial_phase,

271	        limit: int = 50,

274	        """Newest-first paged history; filters compose with AND."""
275	        where: list[str] = []
276	        params: list[object] = []

def _write_llama_server_wrapper(os_key: str, runtime_dir: Path, bin_dir: Path) -> Path:
    """Install a thin launcher on PATH that runs the prebuilt with its libs.

    POSIX: an ``sh`` wrapper that puts the toolchain dir on LD_LIBRARY_PATH (and
    DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH for macOS) before exec. Windows: a ``.cmd`` shim that
    prepends the dir to PATH (Windows resolves DLLs from there). Returns the
    wrapper path.
    """
    if os_key == "win":
        wrapper = bin_dir / "llama-server.cmd"
        wrapper.write_text(
            "@echo off\r\n"
            f'set "PATH={runtime_dir};%PATH%"\r\n'
            f'"{runtime_dir}\\llama-server.exe" %*\r\n'
        )
    else:
        wrapper = bin_dir / "llama-server"
        wrapper.write_text(
            "#!/bin/sh\n"
            "# Auto-generated by `agentalloy pull-models`. Runs the prebuilt\n"
            "# llama-server with its co-located shared libraries on the loader path.\n"
            f'LLAMA_LIB_DIR="{runtime_dir}"\n'
            'export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$LLAMA_LIB_DIR:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"\n'
            'export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$LLAMA_LIB_DIR:${DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"\n'
            'exec "$LLAMA_LIB_DIR/llama-server" "$@"\n'
        )
    wrapper.chmod(0o755)
    return wrapper


def _download_prebuilt_llama_server(hardware: str = "cpu") -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Download + install a prebuilt llama-server from ggml-org releases.

    Resolves this platform + hardware target's asset — a GPU-offload build for
    ``nvidia``/``radeon`` where one is published (Linux Vulkan, Windows CUDA/HIP;
    apple-silicon's Metal ships in the macos-arm64 build), else the plain-CPU
    build — downloads it with the GGUF retry/backoff, extracts the toolchain into
    a permanent runtime dir, installs a wrapper on PATH, and (for GPU targets)
    verifies a GPU device is actually visible so ``-ngl`` won't silently no-op.

    Returns ``{success, binary_path, backend, warning, error, hint, duration_ms}``.
    """
    resolved = _prebuilt_asset(hardware)

    bin_dir = _LLAMA_SERVER_BIN_DIR
